item.tib: che mchog dran pa yang gsang drag po'i rgyud rtsang rab dregs pa dgyes bzhed
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas rab brtan phag lo'i zla tshes kyi nyin yang rong bzhi shar phyogs gnas chen ri yi byang phyogs/ nyi ma rang shar gnas kyi g.yon 'dun seng gdong phug nas/ rigs mthun gyi mkha' 'gro karma DAk+khI grogs bcas te spyan drangs pa'i slar zla tshes kyi bsod nams can gyi pho brang chen po drug zur rnam rgyal rdzong gi dbus rtse la shog ser bod yig du (tu) phab grub pa'o//
